content.subject: Reconciliation sprawl with new CFO
content.draft_text:
Hi Stephanie Fielding,
New finance chief at Stord, former Butterfly CFO.
Rapid expansion and new leadership often cause intercompany reconciliation sprawl.
We build scripts that pull transaction data from ERP, marketing, and logistics systems into a unified ledger for automated reconciliation.
Worth a 15‑minute call next week? — Zamp
